notablePrerequisites:
Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
You have at least one creature card exiled with Dino DNA.
description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {2}, creating a token copy of a creature exiled with it that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
